demo.title: hoodgrow-x402.sh
demo.code:
# HoodGrow: Robinhood Chain stock token data.
# The full catalog is FREE - no key, no payment, no signup. Deeper per-token endpoints are
# $0.05 pay-per-call over x402 (USDC on Base), or free with a self-serve API key from
# https://www.hoodgrow.com/profile (40 req/day), or from a prepaid credit balance.
# The paid endpoints ask on the FIRST call - there is no anonymous allowance.

# 1) The free catalog - send nothing, get 200
curl -s "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/tokens"              # every token: price, 24h, adjusted supply - FREE

# 2) The paid endpoints - no key means HTTP 402 on the first call, with payment terms
#    in the `payment-required` response header
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/ping"            # test the payment path - $0.001
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/token/NVDA"      # one symbol, incl. DeFi depth - $0.05
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/defi/NVDA"       # every Morpho market + Uniswap pool - $0.05
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/corporate-actions"     # corporate actions only - $0.05
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/markets?limit=5" # top gainers/losers/volume/TVL - $0.05
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/trades?symbol=NVDA" # recent large (whale) trades - $0.05

# 3) Pay the advertised USDC amount on Base with your x402-capable agent/wallet,
#    then retry the same URL with the payment proof to receive JSON. Or add
#    `-H "Authorization: Bearer <key>"` with a free or paid key, or the
#    X-HoodGrow-Credit-* headers with a prepaid balance (see
#    POST /api/agent/credits/purchase), instead of paying per call.
#    Every 402 body names the free alternatives too, not just the price.

# 4) Retrying a paid call? Send an Idempotency-Key. The first 2xx is stored for
#    24h and a retry with the same key replays it WITHOUT charging again
#    (metered GETs only - a credit-bundle purchase is NOT covered):
KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -s -H "Idempotency-Key: $KEY" "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/token/NVDA"

# Human-readable docs: https://docs.hoodgrow.com

setup: No signup required, and the full catalog needs nothing at all. For the deeper per-token endpoints: an x402-capable agent/wallet funded with USDC on Base, a free self-serve API key from https://www.hoodgrow.com/profile (40 requests/day, no payment), or a prepaid credit balance (see below). Those endpoints ask on the first call; only the catalog is free without one.

Start with `GET https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/tokens` — the full catalog, FREE, no key and no payment: every token's symbol, name, contract address, price, 24h change and corporate-action adjusted supply, plus pending and recent corporate actions. It carries no per-token DeFi depth; that lives in the paid endpoints. Those are all $0.05: `/api/agent/token/{symbol}` (one token incl. DeFi), `/api/corporate-actions` (corporate actions feed), `/api/agent/defi/{symbol}`, `/api/agent/holders/{symbol}`, `/api/agent/slippage/{symbol}`, `/api/agent/ohlc/{symbol}` (OHLC + swap volume), `/api/agent/markets` (movers), `/api/agent/trades` (recent large trades), `/api/agent/base/tokens` (Base B20 registry + DEX stats). New integration? Call `/api/agent/ping` first — $0.001 to prove the payment path works before spending real money. See SKILL.md.
With a key: send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Without one: on HTTP 402, pay the advertised USDC amount on Base and retry to receive structured JSON.

Prepaid credits: `POST https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/credits/purchase?bundle=<id>` (x402-payable, GET the same URL for the bundle catalog) once, then send `X-HoodGrow-Credit-Wallet` / `-Timestamp` / `-Signature` headers on any call above to spend from the balance instead of paying x402 per call — see SKILL.md's "Prepaid credits" section for the exact signed-message format.

Or skip raw HTTP: `npm i hoodgrow` / `pip install hoodgrow` for a typed client that handles x402 payment (or a bearer key) for you, or `npx hoodgrow-mcp` for an MCP server if your agent is an MCP client.
